7:122.tr: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

1:4.tr: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

11:64.ar: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ ءَايَةٗۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَأۡكُلۡ فِيٓ أَرۡضِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٞ قَرِيبٞ
11:64.wbw: And O my people! This she-camel (of) Allah (is) for you a Sign so leave her to eat in the earth (of) Allah and (do) not touch her with harm lest will seize you a punishment impending"
11:64.tr: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment.

15:62.wbw: He said "Indeed you (are) a people unknown"
15:62.tr: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

26:128.wbw: Do you construct on every elevation a sign amusing yourselves
26:128.tr: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

26:2.wbw: These (are the) Verses (of) the Book clear
26:2.tr: These are the verses of the clear Book.

38:37.wbw: And the devils every builder and diver
38:37.tr: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

38:19.wbw: And the birds assembled all with him repeatedly turning
38:19.tr: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

26:107.wbw: Indeed I am to you a Messenger trustworthy
26:107.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

37:9.wbw: Repelled; and for them (is) a punishment perpetual
37:9.tr: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

71:15.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا
71:15.wbw: Do not you see how did create Allah (the) seven heavens (in) layers
71:15.tr: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

81:11.wbw: And when the sky is stripped away
81:11.tr: And when the sky is stripped away

81:14.wbw: Will know a soul what it has brought
81:14.tr: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

19:89.wbw: Verily you have put forth a thing atrocious
19:89.tr: You have done an atrocious thing.

86:7.wbw: Coming forth from between the backbone and the ribs
86:7.tr: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

41:3.ar: كِتَٰبٞ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
41:3.wbw: A Book are detailed its Verses a Quran (in) Arabic for a people who know
41:3.tr: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know,

4:122.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَمَنۡ أَصۡدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ قِيلٗا
4:122.wbw: And those who believe[d] and do [the] righteous deeds We will admit them (in) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers will abide in it forever A Promise (of) Allah (in) truth and who (is) truer than Allah (in) statement?
4:122.tr: But the ones who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. [It is] the promise of Allah, [which is] truth, and who is more truthful than Allah in statement.

18:98.ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّيۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي حَقّٗا
18:98.wbw: He said "This (is) a mercy from my Lord But when comes (the) Promise (of) my Lord He will make it level And is (the) Promise (of) my Lord true"
18:98.tr: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."

56:45.wbw: Indeed they were before that indulging in affluence
56:45.tr: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

44:11.wbw: Enveloping the people This (will be) a punishment painful
44:11.tr: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

80:18.wbw: From what thing He created him?
80:18.tr: From what substance did He create him?

37:29.wbw: They will say "Nay not you were believers
37:29.tr: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

38:88.wbw: And surely you will know its information after a time"
38:88.tr: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time.

68:34.ar: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
68:34.wbw: Indeed for the righteous with their Lord (are) Gardens (of) Delight
68:34.tr: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

54:55.ar: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
54:55.wbw: In a seat (of) honor near a King Most Powerful
54:55.tr: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

19:78.ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا
19:78.wbw: Has he looked (into) the unseen or has he taken from the Most Gracious a promise?
19:78.tr: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

87:17.wbw: While the Hereafter (is) better and ever lasting
87:17.tr: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

3:54.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمَٰكِرِينَ
3:54.wbw: And they schemed and planned Allah And Allah (is the) best (of) the planners
3:54.tr: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners.

99:7.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
99:7.wbw: So whoever does (equal to the) weight (of) an atom good will see it
99:7.tr: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

6:55.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِتَسۡتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
6:55.wbw: And thus We explain the Verses so that becomes manifest (the) way (of) the criminals
6:55.tr: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.

51:44.ar: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
51:44.wbw: But they rebelled against (the) Command (of) their Lord so seized them the thunderbolt while they were looking
51:44.tr: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

4:70.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ عَلِيمٗا
4:70.wbw: That (is) the Bounty of Allah and sufficient Allah (as) All-Knower
4:70.tr: That is the bounty from Allah, and sufficient is Allah as Knower.

3:63.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
3:63.wbw: And if they turn back then indeed Allah (is) All-Knowing of the corrupters
3:63.tr: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allah is Knowing of the corrupters.

3:34.ar: ذُرِّيَّةَۢ بَعۡضُهَا مِنۢ بَعۡضٖۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
3:34.wbw: Descendents some of them from others And Allah (is) All-Hearing All-Knowing
3:34.tr: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

69:44.wbw: And if he (had) fabricated against Us some sayings
69:44.tr: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

51:58.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
51:58.wbw: Indeed Allah He (is) the All-Provider Possessor (of) Power the Strong
51:58.tr: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

7:76.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
7:76.wbw: Said those who were arrogant "Indeed we in that which you believe in it (are) disbelievers"
7:76.tr: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."

57:3.ar: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
57:3.wbw: He (is) the First and the Last and the Apparent and the Unapparent and He (is) of every thing All-Knower
57:3.tr: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

26:90.wbw: And (will be) brought near the Paradise for the righteous
26:90.tr: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

51:36.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
51:36.wbw: But not We found therein other than a house of the Muslims
51:36.tr: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

39:28.ar: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
39:28.wbw: A Quran (in) Arabic without any crookedness that they may become righteous
39:28.tr: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

26:29.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
26:29.wbw: He said "If you take a god other than me I will surely make you among those imprisoned"
26:29.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

101:11.tr: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

71:25.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا
71:25.wbw: Because of their sins they were drowned then made to enter (the) Fire and not they found for themselves from besides Allah any helpers
71:25.tr: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

15:12.wbw: Thus We let it enter in (the) hearts (of) the criminals
15:12.tr: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

16:75.ar: ۞ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبۡدٗا مَّمۡلُوكٗا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَمَن رَّزَقۡنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرّٗا وَجَهۡرًاۖ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوُۥنَۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
16:75.wbw: Allah sets forth Allah sets forth the example (of) a slave (who is) owned not he has power on anything and (one) whom We provided him from Us a provision good so he spends from it secretly and publicly Can they be equal? All praise (is) for Allah! Nay but most of them (do) not know
16:75.tr: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.

21:14.wbw: They said "O woe to us! Indeed [we] we were wrongdoers"
21:14.tr: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

5:65.ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّقَوۡاْ لَكَفَّرۡنَا عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
5:65.wbw: And if that (the) People (of) the Book (had) believed and feared (Allah) surely We (would have) removed from them their evil (deeds) and surely We (would have) admitted them [to] Gardens (of) Bliss
5:65.tr: And if only the People of the Scripture had believed and feared Allah, We would have removed from them their misdeeds and admitted them to Gardens of Pleasure.

7:57.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَقَلَّتۡ سَحَابٗا ثِقَالٗا سُقۡنَٰهُ لِبَلَدٖ مَّيِّتٖ فَأَنزَلۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡمَآءَ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
7:57.wbw: And He (is) the One Who sends the winds (as) glad tidings from before His Mercy until when they have carried clouds heavy We drive them to a land dead then We send down from it the water then We bring forth from it (of) all (kinds) (of) fruits Thus We will bring forth the dead so that you may take heed
7:57.tr: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.

111:1.wbw: Perish (the) hands (of) Abu Lahab and perish he
111:1.tr: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

41:32.wbw: A hospitable gift from (the) Oft-Forgiving (the) Most Merciful"
41:32.tr: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful.

79:38.wbw: And preferred the life (of) the world
79:38.tr: And preferred the life of the world,

21:107.wbw: And not We have sent you but (as) a mercy for the worlds
21:107.tr: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

37:107.wbw: And We ransomed him with a sacrifice great
37:107.tr: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

4:67.ar: وَإِذٗا لَّأٓتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّن لَّدُنَّآ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
4:67.wbw: And then We would (have) given them from Ourselves a reward great
4:67.tr: And then We would have given them from Us a great reward.

52:40.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
52:40.wbw: Or (do) you ask from them a payment so they from a debt (are) overburdened
52:40.tr: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

53:35.wbw: Is with him (the) knowledge (of) the unseen so he sees?
53:35.tr: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

48:19.ar: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا
48:19.wbw: And spoils of war much that they will take; and is Allah All-Mighty All-Wise
48:19.tr: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

15:25.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
15:25.wbw: And indeed your Lord He will gather them Indeed He (is) All-Wise All-Knowing
15:25.tr: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

110:2.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
110:2.wbw: And you see the people entering into (the) religion (of) Allah (in) multitudes
110:2.tr: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

36:58.wbw: "Peace" A word from a Lord Most Merciful
36:58.tr: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

51:8.wbw: Indeed you (are) surely in a speech differing
51:8.tr: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

81:25.wbw: And not it (is the) word (of) Shaitaan accursed
81:25.tr: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

6:112.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلۡجِنِّ يُوحِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ زُخۡرُفَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ غُرُورٗاۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ
6:112.wbw: And thus We made for every Prophet an enemy devils (from) the mankind and the jinn inspiring some of them to others (with) decorative [the] speech (in) deception But if (had) willed your Lord not they (would) have done it so leave them and what they invent
6:112.tr: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent.

43:8.ar: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
43:8.wbw: Then We destroyed stronger than them (in) power and has passed (the) example (of) the former (people)
43:8.tr: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

43:60.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
43:60.wbw: And if We willed surely We (could have) made among you Angels in the earth succeeding
43:60.tr: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.

42:31.ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
42:31.wbw: And not you (can) escape in the earth and not for you besides besides Allah any protector and not any helper
42:31.tr: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.

8:73.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍۚ إِلَّا تَفۡعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتۡنَةٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَفَسَادٞ كَبِيرٞ
8:73.wbw: And those who disbelieve some of them (are) allies (to) another If not you do it (there) will be oppression in the earth and corruption great
8:73.tr: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption.

74:12.wbw: And I granted to him wealth extensive
74:12.tr: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

27:2.wbw: A guidance and glad tidings for the believers
27:2.tr: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

44:57.ar: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
44:57.wbw: A Bounty from your Lord That - it (will be) the success the great
44:57.tr: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

44:23.wbw: Then Set out with My slaves (by) night Indeed you (will be) followed
44:23.tr: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

74:19.wbw: So may he be destroyed how he plotted!
74:19.tr: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

8:3.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
8:3.wbw: Those who establish the prayer and out of what We have provided them they spend
8:3.tr: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

77:16.wbw: Did not We destroy the former (people)?
77:16.tr: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

39:12.wbw: And I am commanded that I be (the) first (of) those who submit"
39:12.tr: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims.

37:71.wbw: And verily went astray before them most (of) the former (people)
37:71.tr: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

34:35.ar: وَقَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَكۡثَرُ أَمۡوَٰلٗا وَأَوۡلَٰدٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
34:35.wbw: And they say "We (have) more wealth and children and not we will be punished"
34:35.tr: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

26:197.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
26:197.wbw: Is it not Is it not to them a sign that know it (the) scholars (of the) Children (of) Israel?
26:197.tr: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

6:100.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمۡۖ وَخَرَقُواْ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتِۭ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
6:100.wbw: And they make with Allah partners - jinn though He has created them and they falsely attribute to Him sons and daughters without knowledge Glorified is He and Exalted above what they attribute
6:100.tr: But they have attributed to Allah partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters. Exalted is He and high above what they describe

74:39.tr: Except the companions of the right,

14:29.wbw: Hell (in) it they will burn and a wretched place to settle
14:29.tr: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

38:87.wbw: Not it (is) except a Reminder to the worlds
38:87.tr: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

33:41.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ ذِكۡرٗا كَثِيرٗا
33:41.wbw: O you who believe! O you who believe! O you who believe! Remember Allah (with) remembrance much
33:41.tr: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance

78:8.tr: And We created you in pairs

66:5.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُۥٓ أَزۡوَٰجًا خَيۡرٗا مِّنكُنَّ مُسۡلِمَٰتٖ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٖ قَٰنِتَٰتٖ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٖ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٖ ثَيِّبَٰتٖ وَأَبۡكَارٗا
66:5.wbw: Perhaps his Lord if he divorced you [that] He will substitute for him wives better than you submissive faithful obedient repentant who worship who fast previously married and virgins
66:5.tr: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.

2:179.ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡقِصَاصِ حَيَوٰةٞ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
2:179.wbw: And for you in the legal retribution (is) life O men (of) understanding! So that you may (become) righteous
2:179.tr: And there is for you in legal retribution [saving of] life, O you [people] of understanding, that you may become righteous.

23:81.ar: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
23:81.wbw: Nay they say (the) like (of) what said the former (people)
23:81.tr: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

11:89.ar: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِيٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثۡلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوحٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُودٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ صَٰلِحٖۚ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوطٖ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٖ
11:89.wbw: And O my people! (Let) not cause you to sin (Let) not cause you to sin my dissension lest befalls you similar (to) what befell (the) people of Nuh (the) people of Nuh or (the) people of Hud (the) people of Hud or people of Salih people of Salih And not (are the) people of Lut (are the) people of Lut from you far off
11:89.tr: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.

37:112.wbw: And We gave him glad tidings of Ishaq a Prophet among the righteous
37:112.tr: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

12:77.ar: ۞قَالُوٓاْ إِن يَسۡرِقۡ فَقَدۡ سَرَقَ أَخٞ لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ وَلَمۡ يُبۡدِهَا لَهُمۡۚ قَالَ أَنتُمۡ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗاۖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ
12:77.wbw: They said "If he steals then verily stole a brother of his before" before" But Yusuf kept it secret But Yusuf kept it secret within himself and (did) not reveal it to them He said "You (are the) worse (in) position and Allah knows best of what you describe"
12:77.tr: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said, "You are worse in position, and Allah is most knowing of what you describe."

21:72.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةٗۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
21:72.wbw: And We bestowed on him Ishaq and Yaqub (in) addition and all We made righteous
21:72.tr: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

90:5.ar: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
90:5.wbw: Does he think that not has power over him anyone?
90:5.tr: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

23:11.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
23:11.wbw: Who will inherit the Paradise They therein (will) abide forever
23:11.tr: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

43:74.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
43:74.wbw: Indeed the criminals (will be) in (the) punishment (of) Hell abiding forever
43:74.tr: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

1:2.wbw: All praises and thanks (be) to Allah (the) Lord (of all) the worlds
1:2.tr: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

84:24.wbw: So give them tidings of a punishment painful
84:24.tr: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

2:115.ar: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُۚ فَأَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّواْ فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ
2:115.wbw: And for Allah (is) the east and the west so wherever you turn [so] there (is the) face (of) Allah Indeed Allah (is) All-Encompassing All-Knowing
2:115.tr: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

24:1.ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهَا وَفَرَضۡنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
24:1.wbw: A Surah - We (have) sent it down and We (have) made it obligatory and We (have) revealed therein Verses clear so that you may take heed
24:1.tr: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

18:7.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا
18:7.wbw: Indeed We We have made what (is) on the earth adornment for it that We may test [them] which of them (is) best (in) deed
18:7.tr: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

21:82.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعۡمَلُونَ عَمَلٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
21:82.wbw: And of the devils (were some) who would dive for him and would do work other than that And We were of them Guardians
21:82.tr: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.

53:34.wbw: And gave a little and withheld?
53:34.tr: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

33:18.ar: ۞قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلۡقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡ هَلُمَّ إِلَيۡنَاۖ وَلَا يَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡبَأۡسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
33:18.wbw: Verily Allah knows Allah knows those who hinder among you and those who say to their brothers "Come to us" and not they come (to) the battle except a few
33:18.tr: Already Allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,

85:21.tr: But this is an honored Qur'an

75:1.wbw: Nay! I swear by (the) Day (of) the Resurrection
75:1.tr: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

44:28.wbw: Thus And We made it (an) inherit(ance) (for) a people another
44:28.tr: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

4:91.ar: سَتَجِدُونَ ءَاخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَأۡمَنُوكُمۡ وَيَأۡمَنُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ كُلَّ مَا رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلۡفِتۡنَةِ أُرۡكِسُواْ فِيهَاۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ يَعۡتَزِلُوكُمۡ وَيُلۡقُوٓاْ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ وَيَكُفُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فَخُذُوهُمۡ وَٱقۡتُلُوهُمۡ حَيۡثُ ثَقِفۡتُمُوهُمۡۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ جَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗا مُّبِينٗا
4:91.wbw: You will find others wishing that they be secure from you and they be secure from their people Everytime that they are returned to the temptation they are plunged into it So if not they withdraw from you and offer to you [the] peace and they restrain their hands then seize them and kill them wherever you find them And those We made for you against them an authority clear
4:91.tr: You will find others who wish to obtain security from you and [to] obtain security from their people. Every time they are returned to [the influence of] disbelief, they fall back into it. So if they do not withdraw from you or offer you peace or restrain their hands, then seize them and kill them wherever you overtake them. And those - We have made for you against them a clear authorization.

34:15.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لِسَبَإٖ فِي مَسۡكَنِهِمۡ ءَايَةٞۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٖ وَشِمَالٖۖ كُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥۚ بَلۡدَةٞ طَيِّبَةٞ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٞ
34:15.wbw: Certainly (there) was for Saba in their dwelling place a sign: Two gardens on (the) right and (on the) left "Eat from (the) provision (of) your Lord and be grateful to Him A land good and a Lord Oft-Forgiving"
34:15.tr: There was for [the tribe of] Saba' in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."

68:39.ar: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
68:39.wbw: Or (do) you have oaths from us reaching to (the) Day (of) the Resurrection That for you (is) what you judge?
68:39.tr: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

3:96.ar: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيۡتٖ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
3:96.wbw: Indeed (the) first House set up for the mankind (is) the one which (is) at Bakkah blessed and a guidance for the worlds
3:96.tr: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.

15:5.ar: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
15:5.wbw: Not (can) advance any nation its term and not (can) delay it
15:5.tr: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

7:159.ar: وَمِن قَوۡمِ مُوسَىٰٓ أُمَّةٞ يَهۡدُونَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعۡدِلُونَ
7:159.wbw: And among (the) people (of) Musa (is) a community (which) guides with truth and by it establishes justice
7:159.tr: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice.

24:31.ar: وَقُل لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَغۡضُضۡنَ مِنۡ أَبۡصَٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحۡفَظۡنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبۡدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَاۖ وَلۡيَضۡرِبۡنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّۖ وَلَا يُبۡدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوۡ بَنِيٓ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوۡ بَنِيٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوۡ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيۡرِ أُوْلِي ٱلۡإِرۡبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفۡلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَظۡهَرُواْ عَلَىٰ عَوۡرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِۖ وَلَا يَضۡرِبۡنَ بِأَرۡجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعۡلَمَ مَا يُخۡفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّۚ وَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
24:31.wbw: And say to the believing women (that) they should lower [of] their gaze and they should guard their chastity and not (to) display their adornment except what is apparent of it And let them draw their head covers over their bosoms and not (to) display their adornment except to their husbands or their fathers or fathers (of) their husbands or their sons or sons (of) their husbands or their brothers or sons (of) their brothers or sons (of) their sisters or their women or what possess their right hands or the attendants having no physical desire having no physical desire having no physical desire among [the] men or [the] children who (are) not aware of private aspects (of) the women And not let them stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment And turn to Allah altogether O believers! O believers! So that you may succeed
24:31.tr: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

25:38.ar: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرٗا
25:38.wbw: And Ad and Thamud and (the) dwellers (of) Ar-rass and generations between that many
25:38.tr: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.

78:14.wbw: And We sent down from the rain clouds water pouring abundantly
78:14.tr: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

19:34.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
19:34.wbw: That (was) Isa (the) son (of) Maryam a statement (of) truth that which about it they dispute
19:34.tr: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

29:9.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
29:9.wbw: And those who believe and do righteous deeds We will surely admit them among the righteous
29:9.tr: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

18:46.ar: ٱلۡمَالُ وَٱلۡبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ أَمَلٗا
18:46.wbw: The wealth and children (are) adornment (of) the life (of) the world But the enduring good deeds (are) better near your Lord (for) reward and better (for) hope
18:46.tr: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.

56:87.wbw: Bring it back if you are truthful
56:87.tr: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

3:42.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
3:42.wbw: And when said the Angels "O Maryam! Indeed Allah (has) chosen you and purified you and chosen you over (the) women (of) the worlds"
3:42.tr: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

35:23.tr: You, [O Muhammad], are not but a warner.

16:34.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
16:34.wbw: Then struck them (the) evil (results) (of) what they did and surrounded them what they used (to) [of it] mock
16:34.tr: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

18:77.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةٍ ٱسۡتَطۡعَمَآ أَهۡلَهَا فَأَبَوۡاْ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارٗا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥۖ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرٗا
18:77.wbw: So they set out until when they came (to the) people (of) a town they asked for food (from) its people but they refused to offer them hospitality Then they found in it a wall (that) want(ed) to collapse so he set it straight He said "If you wished surely you (could) have taken for it a payment"
18:77.tr: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."

11:117.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ
11:117.wbw: And not would your Lord destroy the cities unjustly while its people (were) reformers
11:117.tr: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.

88:12.tr: Within it is a flowing spring.

21:61.ar: قَالُواْ فَأۡتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُونَ
21:61.wbw: They said "Then bring him before (the) eyes (of) the people so that they may bear witness"
21:61.tr: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

10:50.ar: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوۡ نَهَارٗا مَّاذَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
10:50.wbw: Say "Do you see if comes to you His punishment (by) night or (by) day what (portion) of it would (wish to) hasten of it would (wish to) hasten the criminals?"
10:50.tr: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"

33:11.ar: هُنَالِكَ ٱبۡتُلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَزُلۡزِلُواْ زِلۡزَالٗا شَدِيدٗا
33:11.wbw: There - were tried the believers and shaken (with a) shake severe
33:11.tr: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

85:9.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
85:9.wbw: The One Who for Him (is) the dominion (of) the heavens and the earth; and Allah on every thing (is) a Witness
85:9.tr: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.

19:88.wbw: And they say "Has taken the Most Gracious a son"
19:88.tr: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

4:176.ar: يَسۡتَفۡتُونَكَ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفۡتِيكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكَلَٰلَةِۚ إِنِ ٱمۡرُؤٌاْ هَلَكَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَهُۥٓ أُخۡتٞ فَلَهَا نِصۡفُ مَا تَرَكَۚ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَآ إِن لَّمۡ يَكُن لَّهَا وَلَدٞۚ فَإِن كَانَتَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَلَهُمَا ٱلثُّلُثَانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَۚ وَإِن كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَةٗ رِّجَالٗا وَنِسَآءٗ فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثۡلُ حَظِّ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۗ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ أَن تَضِلُّواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ
4:176.wbw: They seek your ruling Say "Allah gives you a ruling concerning the Kalala if a man died (and) not he has a child and he has a sister then for her (is) a half (of) what he left And he will inherit from her if not is for her a child But if there were two females then for them two thirds of what he left But if they were brothers and sisters men and women then the male will have like share (of) the two females makes clear Allah to you lest you go astray And Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower
4:176.tr: They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allah gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two-thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allah makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

37:41.wbw: Those for them (will be) a provision determined
37:41.tr: Those will have a provision determined -

71:12.ar: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا
71:12.wbw: And provide you with wealth and children and make for you gardens and make for you rivers
71:12.tr: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

17:103.ar: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسۡتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعٗا
17:103.wbw: So he intended to drive them out from the land but We drowned him and who (were) with him all
17:103.tr: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.

79:27.ar: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
79:27.wbw: Are you a more difficult creation or the heaven He constructed it?
79:27.tr: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

7:135.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلرِّجۡزَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ هُم بَٰلِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
7:135.wbw: But when We removed from them the punishment till a (fixed) term (which) they were to reach [it] then they broke (the word)
7:135.tr: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.

77:46.wbw: Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed you (are) criminals"
77:46.tr: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

20:6.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
20:6.wbw: To Him (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth and whatever (is) between them and whatever (is) under the soil
20:6.tr: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

5:66.ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ أَقَامُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ لَأَكَلُواْ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِهِمۚ مِّنۡهُمۡ أُمَّةٞ مُّقۡتَصِدَةٞۖ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
5:66.wbw: And if that they had stood fast (by) the Taurat and the Injeel and what was revealed to them from their Lord surely they (would have) eaten from above them and from beneath their feet Among them (is) a community moderate but many of them - evil (is) what they do
5:66.tr: And if only they upheld [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to them from their Lord, they would have consumed [provision] from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them are a moderate community, but many of them - evil is that which they do.

20:35.wbw: Indeed [You] You are of us All-Seer"
20:35.tr: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing.

27:11.ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
27:11.wbw: Except who wrongs then substitutes good after evil then indeed I Am Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
27:11.tr: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

25:3.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مَوۡتٗا وَلَا حَيَوٰةٗ وَلَا نُشُورٗا
25:3.wbw: Yet they have taken besides Him besides Him gods not they create anything while they are created and not they possess for themselves any harm and not any benefit and not they control death and not life and not resurrection
25:3.tr: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

43:62.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
43:62.wbw: And (let) not avert you the Shaitaan Indeed he (is) for you an enemy clear
43:62.tr: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

26:77.ar: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
26:77.wbw: Indeed they (are) enemies to me except (the) Lord (of) the worlds
26:77.tr: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

16:83.ar: يَعۡرِفُونَ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
16:83.wbw: They recognize (the) Favor (of) Allah; then they deny it And most of them (are) the disbelievers
16:83.tr: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.

15:45.wbw: Indeed the righteous (will be) in Gardens and water springs
15:45.tr: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

84:23.wbw: And Allah (is) most knowing of what they keep within themselves
84:23.tr: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

26:188.wbw: He said "My Lord knows best of what you do"
26:188.tr: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

17:108.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفۡعُولٗا
17:108.wbw: And they say "Glory be to our Lord! Indeed is (the) promise (of) our Lord surely fulfilled"
17:108.tr: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."

35:38.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيۡبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
35:38.wbw: Indeed Allah (is the) Knower (of the) unseen (of) the heavens and the earth Indeed, He (is the) All-Knower of what (is) in the breasts of what (is) in the breasts
35:38.tr: Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

75:7.wbw: So when is dazzled the vision

53:17.wbw: Not swerved the sight and not it transgressed
53:17.tr: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

21:97.ar: وَٱقۡتَرَبَ ٱلۡوَعۡدُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبۡصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
21:97.wbw: And has approached the promise [the] true then behold [it] (are) staring (the) eyes (of) those who disbelieved "O woe to us! Verily we had been in heedlessness of this; nay we were wrongdoers"
21:97.tr: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

24:42.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
24:42.wbw: And to Allah (belongs) (the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth And to Allah (is) the destination
24:42.tr: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination.

38:35.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
38:35.wbw: He said "O my Lord! Forgive me and grant me a kingdom not (will) belong to anyone after me after me Indeed, You [You] (are) the Bestower"
38:35.tr: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

54:1.wbw: Has come near the Hour and has split the moon
54:1.tr: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

6:127.ar: ۞لَهُمۡ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۖ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
6:127.wbw: For them (will be) home (of) [the] peace with their Lord And He (will be) their protecting friend because (of what) they used to do
6:127.tr: For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do.

22:75.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصۡطَفِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ
22:75.wbw: Allah chooses from the Angels Messengers and from the mankind Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer
22:75.tr: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

2:227.ar: وَإِنۡ عَزَمُواْ ٱلطَّلَٰقَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
2:227.wbw: And if they resolve (on) [the] divorce - then indeed Allah (is) All-Hearing All-Knowing
2:227.tr: And if they decide on divorce - then indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

12:78.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبٗا شَيۡخٗا كَبِيرٗا فَخُذۡ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
12:78.wbw: They said "O Aziz! Indeed he has a father old [great] so take one of us (in) his place Indeed we [we] see you of the good-doers"
12:78.tr: They said, "O 'Azeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."

11:1.ar: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أُحۡكِمَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
11:1.wbw: Alif Lam Ra (This is) a Book are perfected its Verses moreover explained in detail from (the One Who) from (the One Who) (is) All-Wise All-Aware
11:1.tr: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.

3:173.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ
3:173.wbw: Those who said to them [the people] "Indeed the people (have) certainly gathered against you so fear them" But it increased them (in the) faith and they said "Sufficient for us (is) Allah and (He is the) best [the] Disposer of affairs"
3:173.tr: Those to whom hypocrites said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs."

11:4.ar: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
11:4.wbw: To Allah (is) your return and He (is) on every thing All-Powerful"
11:4.tr: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent.

3:51.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
3:51.wbw: Indeed Allah (is) my Lord and your Lord so worship Him This (is) the path" straight"
3:51.tr: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path.

4:68.wbw: And We would have guided them (to the) way (the) straight
4:68.tr: And We would have guided them to a straight path.

114:5.wbw: The one who whispers in (the) breasts (of) mankind
114:5.tr: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

15:94.ar: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
15:94.wbw: So proclaim of what you are ordered and turn away from the polytheists
15:94.tr: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

27:93.ar: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعۡرِفُونَهَاۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
27:93.wbw: And say "All praise (be) to Allah He will show you His Signs and you will recognize them And your Lord is not And your Lord is not unaware of what you do"
27:93.tr: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."

26:105.tr: The people of Noah denied the messengers

71:16.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا
71:16.wbw: And made the moon therein a light and made the sun a lamp?
71:16.tr: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

56:24.wbw: A reward for what they used (to) do
56:24.tr: As reward for what they used to do.

43:28.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
43:28.wbw: And he made it a word lasting among his descendents so that they may return
43:28.tr: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

6:18.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
6:18.wbw: And He (is) the Subjugator over His slaves And He (is) the All-Wise the All-Aware
6:18.tr: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].

6:165.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَكُمۡ خَلَٰٓئِفَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ فِي مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ
6:165.wbw: And He (is) the One Who (has) made you successors (of) the earth and raised some of you above others (in) ranks so that He may test you in what He has given you Indeed your Lord (is) swift (in) the punishment and indeed He (is) [certainly] Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
6:165.tr: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

24:40.ar: أَوۡ كَظُلُمَٰتٖ فِي بَحۡرٖ لُّجِّيّٖ يَغۡشَىٰهُ مَوۡجٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ مَوۡجٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ سَحَابٞۚ ظُلُمَٰتُۢ بَعۡضُهَا فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ إِذَآ أَخۡرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمۡ يَكَدۡ يَرَىٰهَاۗ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَجۡعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورٗا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
24:40.wbw: Or (is) like (the) darkness[es] in a sea deep covers it a wave on it on it a wave on it on it a cloud darkness[es] some of it on others When he puts out his hand hardly hardly he (can) see it And (for) whom not Allah (has) made Allah (has) made for him a light then not for him (is) any light
24:40.tr: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light.

37:159.wbw: Glory be (to) Allah above what they attribute
37:159.tr: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,

7:190.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا صَٰلِحٗا جَعَلَا لَهُۥ شُرَكَآءَ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَاۚ فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
7:190.wbw: But when He gives them a good (child) they make for Him partners in what He has given them But exalted (is) Allah above what they associate (with Him)
7:190.tr: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate with Him.

17:43.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا
17:43.wbw: Glorified is He and Exalted is He above what they say (by) height great
17:43.tr: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.

107:4.wbw: So woe to those who pray
107:4.tr: So woe to those who pray

87:1.wbw: Glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most High
87:1.tr: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

24:43.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزۡجِي سَحَابٗا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيۡنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ رُكَامٗا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٖ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٖ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصۡرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرۡقِهِۦ يَذۡهَبُ بِٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
24:43.wbw: Do not you see that Allah drives clouds then joins between them then makes them (into) a mass then you see the rain come forth from their midst? And He sends down from (the) sky [from] mountains within it [of] (is) hail and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills Nearly (the) flash (of) its lighting takes away the sight
24:43.tr: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight.

78:27.wbw: Indeed they were not expecting an account
78:27.tr: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

15:2.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
15:2.wbw: Perhaps will wish those who disbelieved if they had been Muslims
15:2.tr: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

16:128.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ
16:128.wbw: Indeed Allah (is) with those who fear (Him) and those who [they] (are) good-doers
16:128.tr: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

36:24.wbw: Indeed I then surely would be in an error clear
36:24.tr: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

2:263.ar: ۞قَوۡلٞ مَّعۡرُوفٞ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ خَيۡرٞ مِّن صَدَقَةٖ يَتۡبَعُهَآ أَذٗىۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَلِيمٞ
2:263.wbw: A word kind and (seeking) forgiveness (are) better than a charity followed [it] (by) hurt And Allah (is) All-Sufficient All-Forbearing
2:263.tr: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.

60:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ يُبَايِعۡنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشۡرِكۡنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَسۡرِقۡنَ وَلَا يَزۡنِينَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلۡنَ أَوۡلَٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأۡتِينَ بِبُهۡتَٰنٖ يَفۡتَرِينَهُۥ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِنَّ وَأَرۡجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعۡصِينَكَ فِي مَعۡرُوفٖ فَبَايِعۡهُنَّ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
60:12.wbw: O! Prophet! When come to you the believing women pledging to you [on] that not they will associate with Allah anything and not they will steal and not they will commit adultery and not they will kill their children and not they bring slander they invent it between their hands and their feet and not they will disobey you in (the) right then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them (from) Allah Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
60:12.tr: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

16:21.ar: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءٖۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
16:21.wbw: (They are) dead not alive not alive And not they perceive when they will be resurrected
16:21.tr: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.

37:156.wbw: Or (is) for you an authority clear?
37:156.tr: Or do you have a clear authority?

23:34.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَطَعۡتُم بَشَرٗا مِّثۡلَكُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
23:34.wbw: And surely if you obey a man like you indeed you then surely (will be) losers
23:34.tr: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

81:9.wbw: For what sin she was killed
81:9.tr: For what sin she was killed

14:28.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ
14:28.wbw: Have not you seen [to] those who (have) changed (the) Favor (of) Allah (for) disbelief and they led their people (to the) house (of) destruction?
14:28.tr: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?

43:54.ar: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
43:54.wbw: So he bluffed his people and they obeyed him Indeed they were a people defiantly disobedient
43:54.tr: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].

95:4.ar: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
95:4.wbw: Indeed We created man in (the) best mould
95:4.tr: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

19:74.ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثٗا وَرِءۡيٗا
19:74.wbw: And how many We destroyed before them of a generation - they (were) better (in) possessions and appearance?
19:74.tr: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

26:123.wbw: Denied (the people) of Aad the Messengers

28:10.ar: وَأَصۡبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَٰرِغًاۖ إِن كَادَتۡ لَتُبۡدِي بِهِۦ لَوۡلَآ أَن رَّبَطۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
28:10.wbw: And became (the) heart (of the) mother (of) Musa empty That she was near (to) disclosing about him if not that We strengthened [over] her heart so that she would be of the believers
28:10.tr: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

16:117.wbw: An enjoyment little and for them (is) a punishment painful
16:117.tr: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.

79:33.wbw: (As) a provision for you and for your cattle
79:33.tr: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

4:50.ar: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَۖ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦٓ إِثۡمٗا مُّبِينًا
4:50.wbw: See how they invent about Allah [the] lie and sufficient is it - (as) a sin manifest
4:50.tr: Look how they invent about Allah untruth, and sufficient is that as a manifest sin.

37:174.wbw: So turn away from them for a time
37:174.tr: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.

26:218.wbw: The One Who sees you when you stand up
26:218.tr: Who sees you when you arise

2:107.ar: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
2:107.wbw: Do not you know that Allah for Him (is the) Kingdom (of) the heavens and the earth? And not (is) for you from besides Allah any protector and not any helper
2:107.tr: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper?

3:192.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ
3:192.wbw: Our Lord indeed [You] whom You admit (to) the Fire then surely You (have) disgraced him and not for the wrongdoers (are) any helpers
3:192.tr: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.

4:156.ar: وَبِكُفۡرِهِمۡ وَقَوۡلِهِمۡ عَلَىٰ مَرۡيَمَ بُهۡتَٰنًا عَظِيمٗا
4:156.wbw: And for their disbelief and their saying against Maryam a slander great
4:156.tr: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander,

54:27.ar: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
54:27.wbw: Indeed We (are) sending the she-camel (as) a trial for them so watch them and be patient
54:27.tr: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

55:13.wbw: So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny?
55:13.tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

2:149.ar: وَمِنۡ حَيۡثُ خَرَجۡتَ فَوَلِّ وَجۡهَكَ شَطۡرَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
2:149.wbw: And from wherever you start forth [so] turn your face (in the) direction (of) Al-Masjid Al-Haraam And indeed, it (is) surely the truth from your Lord And not (is) Allah unaware of what you do
2:149.tr: So from wherever you go out [for prayer, O Muhammad] turn your face toward al- Masjid al-Haram, and indeed, it is the truth from your Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

9:36.ar: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ ٱلشُّهُورِ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱثۡنَا عَشَرَ شَهۡرٗا فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ يَوۡمَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۡهَآ أَرۡبَعَةٌ حُرُمٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُۚ فَلَا تَظۡلِمُواْ فِيهِنَّ أَنفُسَكُمۡۚ وَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ كَآفَّةٗ كَمَا يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمۡ كَآفَّةٗۚ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
9:36.wbw: Indeed (the) number (of) the months with Allah (is) twelve (is) twelve months in (the) ordinance (of) Allah (from the) Day He created the heavens and the earth of them four (are) sacred That (is) the religion the upright so (do) not wrong therein yourselves And fight the polytheists all together as they fight you all together And know that Allah (is) with the righteous
9:36.tr: Indeed, the number of months with Allah is twelve [lunar] months in the register of Allah [from] the day He created the heavens and the earth; of these, four are sacred. That is the correct religion, so do not wrong yourselves during them. And fight against the disbelievers collectively as they fight against you collectively. And know that Allah is with the righteous [who fear Him].

55:5.wbw: The sun and the moon by (precise) calculation
55:5.tr: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

2:100.ar: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَٰهَدُواْ عَهۡدٗا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
2:100.wbw: And is (it not that) whenever they took a covenant threw it away a party of them? Nay most of them (do) not believe
2:100.tr: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.

16:54.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
16:54.wbw: Then when He removes the adversity from you behold! A group of you with their Lord associate others
16:54.tr: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

23:38.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
23:38.wbw: Not (is) he but a man who (has) invented about Allah a lie and not we (in) him (are) believers"
23:38.tr: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him.

42:11.ar: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
42:11.wbw: (The) Creator (of) the heavens and the earth He made for you from yourselves mates and among the cattle mates; He multiplies you thereby (There) is not like Him anything and He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Seer
42:11.tr: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

3:149.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَرُدُّوكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ فَتَنقَلِبُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
3:149.wbw: O you who believe! If you obey those who disbelieve they will turn you back on your heels then you will turn back (as) losers
3:149.tr: O you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers.

30:39.ar: وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن رِّبٗا لِّيَرۡبُوَاْ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٖ تُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُضۡعِفُونَ
30:39.wbw: And what you give for usury to increase in (the) wealth (of) people not (will) increase with Allah But what you give of zakah desiring (the) Countenance (of) Allah then those [they] (will) get manifold
30:39.tr: And whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of Allah - those are the multipliers.

26:223.wbw: They pass on (what is) heard and most of them (are) liars
26:223.tr: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

3:38.ar: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
3:38.wbw: There only invoked Zakariya his Lord he said "My Lord grant [for] me from Yourself offspring pure Indeed, You (are) All-Hearer (of) the prayer
3:38.tr: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."

7:173.ar: أَوۡ تَقُولُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَشۡرَكَ ءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةٗ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ أَفَتُهۡلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
7:173.wbw: Or you say "Only partners (were) associated (with Allah) (by) our forefathers from before (us) and we are descendants from after them So will You destroy us for what did the falsifiers?"
7:173.tr: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allah before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?"

37:73.wbw: Then see how was (the) end (of) those who were warned
37:73.tr: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

54:50.ar: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
54:50.wbw: And not (is) Our Command but one like the twinkling (of) the eye
54:50.tr: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

31:28.ar: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ
31:28.wbw: Not (is) your creation and not your resurrection but as a soul single Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer
31:28.tr: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

16:122.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
16:122.wbw: And We gave him in the world good and indeed he in the Hereafter (he) will surely (be) among the righteous
16:122.tr: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

37:11.ar: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
37:11.wbw: Then ask them "Are they a stronger creation or (those) whom We have created?" Indeed We created them from a clay sticky
37:11.tr: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.

41:15.ar: فَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
41:15.wbw: Then as for Aad they were arrogant in the earth without [the] right and they said "Who (is) mightier than us (in) strength?" Do not they see that Allah the One Who created them He (is) Mightier than them (in) strength? But they used (to) in Our Signs deny
41:15.tr: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

7:182.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
7:182.wbw: But those who denied Our Signs We will gradually lead them from where not they know
7:182.tr: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.

5:50.ar: أَفَحُكۡمَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ يَبۡغُونَۚ وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حُكۡمٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
5:50.wbw: Is it then the judgment of [the] ignorance they seek? And who (is) better than Allah (in) judgment for a people (who) firmly believe
5:50.tr: Then is it the judgement of [the time of] ignorance they desire? But who is better than Allah in judgement for a people who are certain [in faith].

26:83.ar: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
26:83.wbw: My Lord! Grant [for] me wisdom and join me with the righteous
26:83.tr: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

6:57.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَكَذَّبۡتُم بِهِۦۚ مَا عِندِي مَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰصِلِينَ
6:57.wbw: Say "Indeed I am on clear proof from my Lord while you deny [with] it Not I have what you seek to hasten of it Not (is) the decision except for Allah He relates the truth and He (is the) best (of) the Deciders"
6:57.tr: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."

113:2.tr: From the evil of that which He created

8:22.ar: ۞إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلۡبُكۡمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
8:22.wbw: Indeed worst (of) the living creatures near Allah (are) the deaf the dumb - those who (do) not use their intellect
8:22.tr: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason.

27:33.ar: قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةٖ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِلَيۡكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأۡمُرِينَ
27:33.wbw: They said "We (are) possessors (of) strength and possessors (of) might great and the command (is) up to you so look what you will command"
27:33.tr: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

81:20.ar: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
81:20.wbw: Possessor of power with (the) Owner of the Throne secure
81:20.tr: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

53:50.wbw: And that He destroyed Aad the first
53:50.tr: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad

11:38.ar: وَيَصۡنَعُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَأٞ مِّن قَوۡمِهِۦ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُۚ قَالَ إِن تَسۡخَرُواْ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُونَ
11:38.wbw: And he was constructing the ship and every time passed by him (the) chiefs of his people they ridiculed [of] him He said "If you ridicule us then we can ridicule you as you ridicule
11:38.tr: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.

16:22.ar: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
16:22.wbw: Your god (is) God One But those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter their hearts refuse and they (are) arrogant
16:22.tr: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

2:172.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لِلَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ
2:172.wbw: O you who believe[d]! Eat from (the) good what We have provided you and be grateful to Allah if you alone worship Him
2:172.tr: O you who have believed, eat from the good things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.

26:69.wbw: And recite to them (the) news (of) Ibrahim
26:69.tr: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

48:7.ar: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
48:7.wbw: And for Allah (are the) hosts (of) the heavens and the earth and Allah and Allah (is) All-Mighty All-Wise
48:7.tr: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.

30:51.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيحٗا فَرَأَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا لَّظَلُّواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ يَكۡفُرُونَ
30:51.wbw: But if We sent a wind and they see it turn yellow certainly they continue after it after it (in) disbelief
30:51.tr: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.

7:102.ar: وَمَا وَجَدۡنَا لِأَكۡثَرِهِم مِّنۡ عَهۡدٖۖ وَإِن وَجَدۡنَآ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَفَٰسِقِينَ
7:102.wbw: And not We found for most of them [of] (any) covenant But We found most of them certainly defiantly disobedient
7:102.tr: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient.

6:9.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَلَكٗا لَّجَعَلۡنَٰهُ رَجُلٗا وَلَلَبَسۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّا يَلۡبِسُونَ
6:9.wbw: And if We had made him an Angel certainly We (would) have made him a man and certainly We (would) have obscured to them what they are obscuring
6:9.tr: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves.

5:23.ar: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمۡ غَٰلِبُونَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓاْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
5:23.wbw: Said two men from those who feared (Allah) (had) favored Allah [on] both of them "Enter upon them (through) the gate then when you have entered it then indeed, you (will be) victorious And upon Allah then put your trust if you are believers
5:23.tr: Said two men from those who feared [to disobey] upon whom Allah had bestowed favor, "Enter upon them through the gate, for when you have entered it, you will be predominant. And upon Allah rely, if you should be believers."

69:17.ar: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ ثَمَٰنِيَةٞ
69:17.wbw: And the Angels (will be) on its edges and will bear (the) Throne (of) your Lord above them that Day eight
69:17.tr: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

38:62.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
38:62.wbw: And they will say "What (is) for us not we see men we used (to) count them among the bad ones?
38:62.tr: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

4:115.ar: وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعۡ غَيۡرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِۦ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ وَنُصۡلِهِۦ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرًا
4:115.wbw: And whoever opposes the Messenger from after what (has) become clear to him (of) the guidance and he follows other than (the) way (of) the believers We will turn him (to) what he (has) turned and We will burn him (in) Hell and evil it is (as) a destination
4:115.tr: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers - We will give him what he has taken and drive him into Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

50:43.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
50:43.wbw: Indeed We [We] [We] give life and [We] cause death and to Us (is) the final return
50:43.tr: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

8:34.ar: وَمَا لَهُمۡ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ أَوۡلِيَآءَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
8:34.wbw: But what (is) for them that not (should) punish them Allah while they hinder (people) from Al-Masjid Al-Haraam while not they are its guardians? Not (can be) its guardians except the ones who fear Allah but most of them (do) not know
8:34.tr: But why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al- Haram and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.

2:95.ar: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوۡهُ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
2:95.wbw: And never (will) they wish for it ever because (of what) sent ahead their hands And Allah (is) All-Knower of the wrongdoers
2:95.tr: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

22:50.ar: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ
22:50.wbw: So those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them (is) forgiveness and a provision noble
22:50.tr: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

33:50.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَحۡلَلۡنَا لَكَ أَزۡوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّٰتِيٓ ءَاتَيۡتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَٰلَٰتِكَ ٱلَّٰتِي هَاجَرۡنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمۡرَأَةٗ مُّؤۡمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتۡ نَفۡسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ إِنۡ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَن يَسۡتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةٗ لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۗ قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا فَرَضۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ لِكَيۡلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيۡكَ حَرَجٞۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
33:50.wbw: O Prophet! O Prophet! Indeed, We [We] have made lawful to you your wives (to) whom you have given their bridal money and whom you rightfully possess you rightfully possess from those (whom) Allah has given Allah has given to you and (the) daughters (of) your paternal uncles and (the) daughters (of) your paternal aunts and (the) daughters (of) your maternal uncles and (the) daughters (of) your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a woman believing if she gives herself to the Prophet if wishes the Prophet to marry her only for you excluding excluding the believers Certainly We know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and whom they rightfully possess they rightfully possess that not should be on you any discomfort And Allah is And Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
33:50.tr: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

77:50.wbw: Then in what statement after it will they believe?
77:50.tr: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?

12:111.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٞ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثٗا يُفۡتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصۡدِيقَ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
12:111.wbw: Verily (there) is in their stories a lesson for men (of) understanding Not (it) is a narration invented but a confirmation (of that) which (was) before it (was) before it and a detailed explanation (of) all things and a guidance and mercy for a people who believe
