12:111.tr: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

37:15.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
37:15.wbw: And they say "Not (is) this except a magic clear
37:15.tr: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

7:136.ar: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا غَٰفِلِينَ
7:136.wbw: So We took retribution from them and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our Signs and they were to them heedless
7:136.tr: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.

6:131.ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمۡ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا غَٰفِلُونَ
6:131.wbw: That (is because) [that] not is your Lord one who destroys the cities for their wrongdoing while their people (are) unaware
6:131.tr: That is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware.

9:101.ar: وَمِمَّنۡ حَوۡلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ مُنَٰفِقُونَۖ وَمِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ مَرَدُواْ عَلَى ٱلنِّفَاقِ لَا تَعۡلَمُهُمۡۖ نَحۡنُ نَعۡلَمُهُمۡۚ سَنُعَذِّبُهُم مَّرَّتَيۡنِ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ عَظِيمٖ
9:101.wbw: And among those around you of the bedouins (are) hypocrites and (also) from people (of) the Madinah They persist in the hypocrisy not you know them We [We] know them We will punish them twice then they will be returned to a punishment great
9:101.tr: And among those around you of the bedouins are hypocrites, and [also] from the people of Madinah. They have become accustomed to hypocrisy. You, [O Muhammad], do not know them, [but] We know them. We will punish them twice [in this world]; then they will be returned to a great punishment.

33:73.ar: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمَۢا
33:73.wbw: So that Allah may punish So that Allah may punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women and the polytheist men and the polytheist women and Allah will turn (in Mercy) and Allah will turn (in Mercy) to the believing men and the believing women And Allah is And Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
33:73.tr: [It was] so that Allah may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allah may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

12:7.ar: ۞لَّقَدۡ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخۡوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
12:7.wbw: Certainly were in Yusuf and his brothers signs for those who ask
12:7.tr: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask,

22:43.wbw: And (the) people (of) Ibrahim and (the) people (of) Lut
22:43.tr: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

8:58.ar: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوۡمٍ خِيَانَةٗ فَٱنۢبِذۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡخَآئِنِينَ
8:58.wbw: And if you fear from a people betrayal throw back to them on equal (terms) Indeed Allah (does) not love the traitors
8:58.tr: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allah does not like traitors.

26:136.ar: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
26:136.wbw: They said "(It is) same to us whether you advise or not you are of the advisors
26:136.tr: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

19:22.wbw: So she conceived him and she withdrew with him (to) a place remote
19:22.tr: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

25:34.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا
25:34.wbw: Those who will be gathered on their faces to Hell those (are the) worst (in) position and most astray (from the) way
25:34.tr: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

15:44.ar: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ
15:44.wbw: For it (are) seven gates for each gate among them (is) a portion assigned
15:44.tr: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated.

3:35.ar: إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ عِمۡرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطۡنِي مُحَرَّرٗا فَتَقَبَّلۡ مِنِّيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
3:35.wbw: When [she] said (the) wife (of) Imran "My Lord! Indeed I [I] vowed to You what (is) in my womb dedicated so accept from me Indeed You You (are) the All-Hearing the All-Knowing
3:35.tr: [Mention, O Muhammad], when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."

27:23.ar: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ
27:23.wbw: Indeed I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great
27:23.tr: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

28:23.ar: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيۡهِ أُمَّةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمۡرَأَتَيۡنِ تَذُودَانِۖ قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُمَاۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسۡقِي حَتَّىٰ يُصۡدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيۡخٞ كَبِيرٞ
28:23.wbw: And when he came (to the) water (of) Madyan he found on it a group of men watering and he found besides them besides them two women keeping back He said "What (is the) matter with both of you?" They said "We cannot water "We cannot water until take away the shepherds and our father (is) a very old man" (is) a very old man"
28:23.tr: And when he came to the well of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

8:8.ar: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَيُبۡطِلَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
8:8.wbw: That He might justify the truth and prove false the falsehood even if disliked (it) the criminals
8:8.tr: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

106:4.ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
106:4.wbw: The One Who feeds them against hunger and gives them security against fear
106:4.tr: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

24:4.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ ٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَأۡتُواْ بِأَرۡبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجۡلِدُوهُمۡ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلۡدَةٗ وَلَا تَقۡبَلُواْ لَهُمۡ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدٗاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
24:4.wbw: And those who accuse the chaste women then not they bring four witnesses then flog them (with) eighty lashe(s) and (do) not accept their testimony ever And those they (are) the defiantly disobedient
24:4.tr: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

13:9.wbw: Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed the Most Great the Most High
13:9.tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

9:105.ar: وَقُلِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ فَسَيَرَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمۡ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۖ وَسَتُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
9:105.wbw: And say "Do then Allah will see then Allah will see your deed and His Messenger and the believers And you will be brought back to (the) Knower (of) the unseen and the seen then He will inform you of what you used (to) do"
9:105.tr: And say, "Do [as you will], for Allah will see your deeds, and [so, will] His Messenger and the believers. And you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do."

15:92.wbw: So by your Lord surely We will question them all
15:92.tr: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

86:15.wbw: Indeed they are plotting a plot
86:15.tr: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

86:16.wbw: But I am planning a plan
86:16.tr: But I am planning a plan.

15:61.wbw: And when came (to the) family (of) Lut the messengers
15:61.tr: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

54:41.wbw: And certainly came (to the) people (of) Firaun warnings
54:41.tr: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

4:21.ar: وَكَيۡفَ تَأۡخُذُونَهُۥ وَقَدۡ أَفۡضَىٰ بَعۡضُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ وَأَخَذۡنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظٗا
4:21.wbw: And how could you take it when surely has gone - one of you to another and they have taken from you covenant strong?
4:21.tr: And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?

4:90.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ أَوۡ جَآءُوكُمۡ حَصِرَتۡ صُدُورُهُمۡ أَن يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ أَوۡ يُقَٰتِلُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَسَلَّطَهُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَلَقَٰتَلُوكُمۡۚ فَإِنِ ٱعۡتَزَلُوكُمۡ فَلَمۡ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ وَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ فَمَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبِيلٗا
4:90.wbw: Except those who join [to] a group between you and between them (is) a treaty or those who come to you restraining their hearts that they fight you or they fight their people And if (had) willed Allah surely He (would have) given them power over you and surely they (would have) fought you So if they withdraw from you and (do) not fight against you and offer to you [the] peace then not (has) made Allah for you against them a way
4:90.tr: Except for those who take refuge with a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty or those who come to you, their hearts strained at [the prospect of] fighting you or fighting their own people. And if Allah had willed, He could have given them power over you, and they would have fought you. So if they remove themselves from you and do not fight you and offer you peace, then Allah has not made for you a cause [for fighting] against them.

16:103.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٞۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِي يُلۡحِدُونَ إِلَيۡهِ أَعۡجَمِيّٞ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيّٞ مُّبِينٌ
16:103.wbw: And certainly We know that they say "Only teaches him a human being" (The) tongue (of) the one they refer to him (is) foreign while this (is) a language Arabic clear
16:103.tr: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language.

2:37.ar: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
2:37.wbw: Then received Adam from his Lord words So (his Lord) turned towards him Indeed He! He (is) the Oft-returning (to mercy) the Most Merciful
2:37.tr: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

50:31.wbw: And will be brought near the Paradise to the righteous not far
50:31.tr: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

2:158.ar: ۞إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلۡمَرۡوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَمَنۡ حَجَّ ٱلۡبَيۡتَ أَوِ ٱعۡتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَاۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيۡرٗا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
2:158.wbw: Indeed the Safa and the Marwah (are) from (the) symbols (of) Allah So whoever performs Hajj (of) the House or performs Umrah so no blame on him that he walks between [both of] them And whoever voluntarily does good then indeed Allah (is) All-Appreciative All-Knowing
2:158.tr: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.

4:128.ar: وَإِنِ ٱمۡرَأَةٌ خَافَتۡ مِنۢ بَعۡلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوۡ إِعۡرَاضٗا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَآ أَن يُصۡلِحَا بَيۡنَهُمَا صُلۡحٗاۚ وَٱلصُّلۡحُ خَيۡرٞۗ وَأُحۡضِرَتِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ ٱلشُّحَّۚ وَإِن تُحۡسِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
4:128.wbw: And if a woman fears from her husband ill-conduct or desertion then (there is) no sin on both of them that they make terms of peace between themselves - a reconciliation and [the] reconciliation (is) best And are swayed the souls (by) greed But if you do good and fear (Allah) then indeed Allah is of what you do All-Aware
4:128.tr: And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion, there is no sin upon them if they make terms of settlement between them - and settlement is best. And present in [human] souls is stinginess. But if you do good and fear Allah - then indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted.

18:2.ar: قَيِّمٗا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأۡسٗا شَدِيدٗا مِّن لَّدُنۡهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرًا حَسَنٗا
18:2.wbw: Straight to warn (of) a punishment severe from near Him and give glad tidings (to) the believers those who do righteous deeds that for them (is) a good reward (is) a good reward
18:2.tr: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

4:117.ar: إِن يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ إِنَٰثٗا وَإِن يَدۡعُونَ إِلَّا شَيۡطَٰنٗا مَّرِيدٗا
4:117.wbw: Not they invoke from besides Him but female (deities) and not they invoke except Shaitaan rebellious
4:117.tr: They call upon instead of Him none but female [deities], and they [actually] call upon none but a rebellious Satan.

77:26.tr: Of the living and the dead?

19:66.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
19:66.wbw: And says [the] man "What! When "What! When I am dead surely will I be brought forth alive?"
19:66.tr: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

31:12.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
31:12.wbw: And verily We gave Luqman the wisdom that "Be grateful to Allah" And whoever (is) grateful then only he is grateful for himself And whoever (is) ungrateful then indeed Allah (is) Free of need Praiseworthy
31:12.tr: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

64:6.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٞ يَهۡدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْۖ وَّٱسۡتَغۡنَى ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
64:6.wbw: That (is) because had come to them their Messengers with clear proofs but they said "Shall human beings guide us?" So they disbelieved and turned away And can do without them Allah And Allah (is) Self-sufficient Praiseworthy
64:6.tr: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

9:93.ar: ۞إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُونَكَ وَهُمۡ أَغۡنِيَآءُۚ رَضُواْ بِأَن يَكُونُواْ مَعَ ٱلۡخَوَالِفِ وَطَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
9:93.wbw: Only the way (blame) (is) on those who ask your permission while they (are) rich They (are) satisfied to be with those who stay behind and Allah sealed and Allah sealed [on] their hearts so they (do) not know
9:93.tr: The cause [for blame] is only upon those who ask permission of you while they are rich. They are satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and Allah has sealed over their hearts, so they do not know.

69:34.wbw: And (did) not feel the urge on (the) feeding (of) the poor
69:34.tr: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

84:10.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
84:10.wbw: But as for (him) who is given his record behind his back
84:10.tr: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

23:7.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
23:7.wbw: Then whoever seeks beyond that then those [they] (are) the transgressors
23:7.tr: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

29:5.ar: مَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَأٓتٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
29:5.wbw: Whoever [is] hopes (for the) meeting (with) Allah then indeed (the) Term (of) Allah (is) surely coming And He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower
29:5.tr: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

4:81.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ طَاعَةٞ فَإِذَا بَرَزُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ بَيَّتَ طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي تَقُولُۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَكۡتُبُ مَا يُبَيِّتُونَۖ فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
4:81.wbw: And they say "(We pledge) obedience" Then when they leave from you plan by night a group of them other than that which you say But Allah records what they plan by night So turn (away) from them and put (your) trust in Allah And sufficient is Allah (as) a Trustee
4:81.tr: And they say, "[We pledge] obedience." But when they leave you, a group of them spend the night determining to do other than what you say. But Allah records what they plan by night. So leave them alone and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.

33:13.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ يَثۡرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمۡ فَٱرۡجِعُواْۚ وَيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوۡرَةٞ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوۡرَةٍۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا
33:13.wbw: And when said a party of them "O People (of) Yathrib! No stand for you so return" And asked permission a group of them (from) the Prophet saying "Indeed our houses (are) exposed" and not they (were) exposed Not they wished but to flee
33:13.tr: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.

17:65.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلٗا
17:65.wbw: "Indeed My slaves not for you over them any authority And sufficient (is) your Lord (as) a Guardian"
17:65.tr: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.

33:3.ar: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
33:3.wbw: And put your trust in Allah And Allah is sufficient And Allah is sufficient (as) Disposer of affairs
33:3.tr: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.

68:33.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
68:33.wbw: Such (is) the punishment And surely the punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) greater if they know
68:33.tr: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

6:123.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجۡرِمِيهَا لِيَمۡكُرُواْ فِيهَاۖ وَمَا يَمۡكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
6:123.wbw: And thus We placed in every city greatest (of) its criminals so that they plot therein And not they plot except against themselves and not they perceive
6:123.tr: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not.

37:140.wbw: When he ran away to the ship laden
37:140.tr: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

76:8.ar: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا
76:8.wbw: And they feed the food in spite of love (for) it (to the) needy and (the) orphan and (the) captive
76:8.tr: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

2:184.ar: أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَٰتٖۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ فَعِدَّةٞ مِّنۡ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَۚ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدۡيَةٞ طَعَامُ مِسۡكِينٖۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيۡرٗا فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَن تَصُومُواْ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
2:184.wbw: (Fasting for) days numbered So whoever is among you sick or on a journey then a prescribed number of days other And on those who can afford it a ransom (of) feeding a poor And whoever volunteers good then it (is) better for him And to fast (is) better for you if you know
2:184.tr: [Fasting for] a limited number of days. So whoever among you is ill or on a journey [during them] - then an equal number of days [are to be made up]. And upon those who are able [to fast, but with hardship] - a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]. And whoever volunteers excess - it is better for him. But to fast is best for you, if you only knew.

2:17.ar: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارٗا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ لَّا يُبۡصِرُونَ
2:17.wbw: Their example (is) like (the) example (of) the one who kindled a fire then, when it lighted what his surroundings took away Allah their light and left them in darkness[es] (so) not (do) they see
2:17.tr: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

23:31.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
23:31.wbw: Then We produced after them after them a generation another
23:31.tr: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

25:64.wbw: And those who spend (the) night before their Lord prostrating and standing
25:64.tr: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

6:69.ar: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنۡ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ وَلَٰكِن ذِكۡرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
6:69.wbw: And not (is) on those who fear (Allah) of their account [of] anything; but (for) reminder so that they may fear (Allah)
6:69.tr: And those who fear Allah are not held accountable for the disbelievers at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.

78:12.wbw: And We constructed over you seven strong
78:12.tr: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
